commandPrerequisite: Python with python-docx 1.2.0 on PATH or WITHIN_DOCX_FIXTURE_PYTHON set to that interpreter.
semantics: Run vertAlign is an enumerated override; document defaults, default/named paragraph chains, named character chains, and direct values resolve in that order. Baseline explicitly resets the inherited run shift. Safe fixed HTML tags only.
warnings: DOCX HTML preserves main-document paragraphs, table rows/cells, horizontal grid spans, and standard vertical merges with empty continuation cells. Omitted edge grid positions use empty HTML cells. Direct bold/italic/underline/strike, tabs, line breaks, Unicode and accepted tracked insertions are preserved. Tracked deletions and moved-from text are excluded.

Named styles (referenced/default paragraph and character) preserve outline hierarchy and supported bold/italic/underline/strike emphasis and text colors with direct overrides. Text colors use bounded RGB and theme mapping; automatic color uses the browser text color, not Word's background-dependent choice. Underline patterns/colors are normalized to a single underline. Legacy horizontal merges, table-style effects, complex-script properties, fonts, shading, borders, page layout, fields, images/drawings, headers/footers, notes/comments and document properties are not reproduced. Field display text is retained when present; headings reflow in static HTML, not original Word layout.
Direct and inherited superscript/subscript use semantic HTML; explicit baseline resets are retained. Exact Word font metrics and custom raised/lowered text positions are not reproduced.

Supported DOCX paragraph alignment follows document defaults, paragraph styles and direct overrides, including right-to-left leading and trailing edges. This does not recreate Word's bidirectional run ordering, list tab geometry or exact justification spacing.

Explicit DOCX HTTP/HTTPS/mailto hyperlinks and local bookmark positions are preserved without fetching targets; unsafe/relative/package links retain display text but are inactive. Frame targets, browsing history, document-location hints and field-code links are not reproduced; nested hyperlinks are rejected. Relationships are capped at1MiB/4096entries/1024links and bookmarks at4096names.

Supported DOCX decimal, repeated-letter, Roman and Unicode-bullet list labels, instance continuation, level restarts and inherited paragraph-style numbering are preserved in streamed HTML lists. Marker fonts, original tab stops and indent geometry are normalized; picture/legacy markers, linked numbering styles and other numbering systems are rejected when used.
DOCX outline metadata read 169 style definitions from a referenced internal package part.
initialFocusedAttempt: 29/30: the negative body check accidentally matched the existing table-cell CSS in the document head. Restricting it to body markup fixed the assertion; no product behavior changed for that correction.
limitations: Exact Word font sizing and w:position offsets are not reproduced.
No browser destination/memory, manual, scaling, or public-qualification claim.
